text:
dana: Heads-up: Private VPC GA patch (v1.0.3) rolling out tonight 11pm PT. Main changes: audit-forwarding, mandatory encrypted snapshots, and an updated install script. Docs at: https://internal.redwood.io/docs/private-vpc/1.0.3
ops-bot: Release note uploaded: private-vpc-1.0.3 by dana — 1777102222
hugo: Quick Q: encrypted snapshots = forced for new installs only or retrofit existing customers?
dana: Retrofit for pilot customers only. We will contact existing accounts and schedule a maintenance window. Full policy in release notes.
lenora: Security/Compliance: backup opt-in removed; snapshots now encrypted by default and keys must be KMS/HSM-backed. Adding a legal blurb for EU customers about cross-border metadata.
mike: Ops note: installer now verifies node time + kernel params before starting. Example check in installer: 
```bash
./install.sh --preflight 
# checks: ntp, selinux=permissive, fs.inotify.max_user_instances
```
sabrina: Can we get an example sysadmin playbook for customers to follow during the maintenance window? We need clear rollback steps.
dana: Yes 1 I added a short runbook snippet under "customer-runbooks/v1.0.3" with rollback commands. Example rollback: 
```bash
./installer rollback --to 1.0.2 --preserve-config
```
hugo: Does the rollout impact API surface? any breaking changes?
dana: No API changes. Only infra, snapshot encryption, and audit-forwarding config flags. CLI param renamed: --enable-audit -> --audit-forwarding for clarity.
ops-bot: CI: docs lint passed; installer e2e kicked off 1 build #482 started.
mike: Noted: add a health-check endpoint that returns mounted-volume checks and last-snapshot age. I'll open a small PR.
lenora: Legal request: include a short consent line in the onboarding UI for EU customers who want backups to be stored in a different region. Must be explicit opt-in.
sabrina: Scheduling: pilot customer enablement calls Thurs/Fri. Who can lead tech walkthroughs?
dana: I can handle Thurs AM. Hugo can take Fri with EU pilot.
hugo: I'll also include an HSM connectivity checklist and sample PKCS11 config. Snippet in doc: 
```ini
pkcs11_module = /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
slot = 0
pin = <REDACTED>
```
deploy-bot: Installer CI green for tag v1.0.3 1 all smoke tests passed.
dana: Action items: 1) Security to finalize EU copy (lenora), 2) Ops to publish playbook PR (mike), 3) Sales to get updated one-pager for pilots (sabrina). I'll post status updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
